html:
The VinWonders Nam Hoi An Full Day Tour offers a perfect mix of entertainment, wildlife exploration, cultural performances, and thrilling amusement park experiences. Opened in April 2018, VinWonders Nam Hoi An is one of the newest and most diverse entertainment destinations in Central Vietnam, suitable for families, groups, and travelers of all ages.

ITINERARY

08:00 – 08:30
Driver and English-speaking tour guide from Vietlook Travel pick you up at your hotel. Depart for VinWonders Nam Hoi An.

09:30
Explore Vinpearl Safari Zoo – Vietnam’s first river safari park.

  • Experience wildlife up close, including Bengal tigers, antelopes, kangaroos, rhinos, giraffes, and zebras

  • Enjoy cultural performances at Folk Villages, showcasing traditional Vietnamese music and dances

  • Discover UNESCO-recognized Bac Ninh folk songs and music

  • Witness the unique underwater cultural performance, a highlight of Folklore Island

12:00
Lunch buffet (or set menu during low season).

13:30
Free time to enjoy the amusement and water parks:

  • Indoor playground with 95 interactive games

  • 2D, 3D, and 5D cinemas

  • Thrilling rides including the Tourbillon Whirlwind, 80m Free Fall Tower, and Sicko Super Speed Spin

  • Explore the cultural-themed Harbor area, blending the Old Town charm with Dream Boulevard attractions

17:00
Drop-off at your hotel.

End of tour services. Thank you for traveling with Vietlook Travel!

TOUR PRICE: USD 60 / person

INCLUSIONS

  • Air-conditioned coach for transfers

  • Professional English-speaking tour guide

  • Entrance fee to VinWonders Nam Hoi An

  • Lunch (buffet or set menu)

  • Mineral water

IMPORTANT NOTES

  • Please provide personal information: Full name, year of birth, gender, nationality, and contact details.

  • Children policy (height-based):

    • Under 1 meter: Free of charge (sharing lunch with parents)

    • 1.0 m – 1.4 m: 85% of adult price

    • Above 1.4 m: Full adult price
